profiles.title: Payments L2 specialist
profiles.profile_text:
PS-101 | Payments L2 specialist
FICTIONAL SAMPLE — for product demonstration only

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
- Investigated Linux service failures using journalctl, systemctl and process-level diagnostics.
- Used read-only SQL joins and execution plans to investigate payment reconciliation delays.
- Owned P1 payment incidents, coordinated escalation and sent stakeholder updates every 30 minutes.
- Correlated Splunk logs with Grafana latency alerts to isolate failing downstream services.
- Led a post-incident review that traced retry storms to a timeout mismatch and added a regression test.
- Built a Python health-check script with a dry-run mode and peer-reviewed rollout.
- Observed an AWS failover exercise; the cloud platform team performed the changes.

All organizations and work examples in this profile are fictional.

profiles.title: Cloud operations specialist
profiles.profile_text:
PS-102 | Cloud operations specialist
FICTIONAL SAMPLE — for product demonstration only

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
- Diagnosed Linux disk pressure and memory exhaustion using df, du, free and process metrics.
- Investigated failed orders with read-only PostgreSQL queries and transaction history.
- Served as incident coordinator for a production outage and maintained the escalation timeline.
- Used CloudWatch alarms and Kubernetes pod logs to investigate API error spikes.
- Identified a connection-pool limit as the outage cause and verified the preventive configuration change.
- Created shell scripts for log collection and validated output in a staging environment.
- Troubleshot Kubernetes readiness failures and AWS load-balancer target health.

All organizations and work examples in this profile are fictional.
